run_relatedness_model: run the RelatednessPytorch model on train, valid, and test data to compute Pearson correlation
train_relatedness_epoch: train the RelatednessPytorch model for a specified number of epochs using mini-batch gradient descent
predict_relatedness_proba: predict class probabilities from the trained RelatednessPytorch model on batched input data
prepare_relatedness_data: prepare numpy arrays as CUDA tensors for training, validation, and testing in RelatednessPytorch
build_relatedness_model: build a RelatednessPytorch model with a linear layer and softmax for semantic relatedness scoring
